content.description: From houses, apartment rooms, buildings, and characters, each piece from Beyond Rockets are like jigsaw puzzle pieces that make up the whole metropolis. This mini-collection is the introduction of BYND Studios to Bitcoin and part of the earliest inscriptions in the history of Bitcoin Ordinals. We are a creative studio and marketing agency that transforms ideas into captivating realities. Collecting a piece is like owning a part of the city except its all about art and everything is immortalized on the blockchain. The periodical releases of this series, starting with The First Key featured animated isometric voxel rooms and etched the iconic and signature art style of Beyond Rockets.
